text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Everyone was too strong… and too beautiful!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Everyone was too strong… and too beautiful!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Yeah… If I'm going to run on the same track as the other runners, I have to get better…

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Next time, I'll be in the fray for first! I want to be the closest to my oshis as they butt heads with each other!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: And in the last spurt, I wanna breathe in the air they exhale! If only I could perform photosynthesis!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Yeah… I don't… think I am disappointed. I feel more like… ashamed…

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: I need to be strong enough that I don't embarrass the other racers…

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: You're right! I want to be someone my oshis can be proud of!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: A true fan is inspired by their oshis to do better! Everything for my oshis!
